title: A score of exactly 90 does not get an A
summary: `grade_letter(score)` should return `"A"` for 90 and above, `"B"` for 80-89, `"C"` for 70-79, `"D"` for 60-69, otherwise `"F"`. Right now `grade_letter(90)` returns `"B"`.
hint: Compare how the A check and the B check treat their boundary number.
